% Pattern: head/manual. A bold head of a few words that ends with a title, as
% {\bf Cancelation axiom.} or {\bf Cylindrical case:}, is an item of that
% title, and a head with the title misspelled as Corrolary is a corollary.
% seen in the gold pilot (set X)
% want head-1 statement/axiom -
% want head-2 other/case -
% want head-3 statement/corollary 1.4
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\begin{itemize}
  \item {\bf Cancelation axiom.} Each map of trees has an inverse.
\end{itemize}

\textbf{Cylindrical case:} The tree is a path.

\noindent{\bf Corrolary 1.4.} {\it Each tree with $n$ vertices has $n-1$ edges.}
\end{document}
